title: Three comments still describe planning "under the veil" after this diff deleted the veil
evidence: app/main.odin:193: "// fast-path edit THIS frame — the player plans under the veil, and a"; app/main.odin:220: "// game-over toast). 5.3: Paused keeps the surface (the player plans" / "// under the veil — the live preview + the committed glow stay usable)."; app/main.odin:238: "// 5.3: live while paused too (demolish-and-plan under the veil)."
detail: This diff removed the dim veil but adjacent comments still reference it, misleading future readers about the paused presentation the ruling changed.
recommended_fix: Reword the three comments to say "while paused" (the veil no longer exists).

title: Paused chip hardcodes a third copy of the tray-chip bg color literal
evidence: app/main.odin:261: "rl.DrawRectangleRec(chip, rl.Color{238, 230, 210, 255})"; app/main.odin:1283: "bg := rl.Color{238, 230, 210, 255}"; app/main.odin:1297: "bg := rl.Color{238, 230, 210, 255}"
detail: The chip-bg literal now exists in three places; a future tray-chip recolor will silently miss the paused chip (no shared constant or helper exists).
recommended_fix: Hoist a single CHIP_BG constant (e.g. in app/render/tray.odin beside TRAY_CHIP_W/H) used by draw_tray and the paused chip.
